title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode8 Close and Yet So Far

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Close and Yet So Far
meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_leoneed_op4
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: That was delicious!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting me to have lunch with you today, Saki. It's been so long since we had a chance to sit and chat like this, so I had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I had a lot of fun too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If only I didn't have that practice match on Saturday. We would've been able to chat for longer and go places together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. There you go again.
I thought you decided to do so well that you'd come and tell me that you were the MVP.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! I'm gonna treat it like it's an official match!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's wrong, Ichi...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Nothing.
Your eyes were just twinkling so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I need to keep doing what I can too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I've been meaning to ask you!
You figured out what you want to do, right, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was waiting to tell you until at least the first chorus was complete...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First chorus?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... The thing is, I've been writing my own Miku song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's amazing! What's it like?
Lemme hear it! Please!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa! Settle down, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm actually still not sure what I'm doing. It's really not ready to be heard by anyone else yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been trying a lot of different things I want to hear Miku sing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, can you tell me why you decided to write your own Miku song?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, do you remember Yoisaki?
Honami's been going over to her residence to help with the housework.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You mean the girl you just happened to meet because of that one Miku CD?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I actually ran into her just the other day at the station. That was when I remembered how she uses digital tools... How she composes songs using her computer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That also seems to apply to Miku songs, so I decided to give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I didn't know that...!
Then, that means Miku's gonna be singing the songs you write someday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm also excited about that, but I didn't realize just how hard it is to write your own songs...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll gradually figure things out as long as you keep at it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When I first joined the soft tennis club, I had a ton of trouble with my serves and returns. But I've got those down pat now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's right... No matter how hard things got, Saki never gave up. She kept practicing every single day.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just started doing this, so I shouldn't be acting so pessimistic...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'll do my best to finish my song.
So that Miku can sing it. So that you and the others get to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great! I'll be looking forward to hearing it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, Ichi, thanks for joining me today! Again, I had a lot of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm also glad that we had this chance to talk.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I really did have a lot of fun. Even though all we did was chat while having lunch together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Can we have lunch together again soon...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, so... I really do enjoy having lunch together like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Gathering on a weekend or holiday is challenging since we all have a lot going on, so I thought we could at least have lunch together and chat then...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I also wish we could all have lunch together like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Why don't we try doing that next week?! I can even tell you guys how I did during my practice match!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I'll try asking Honami later.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And I'll let Shiho know!
Anyway, see you later!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See you!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All of us having lunch together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can't wait.)
A few days later - Lunch break
Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
So, Honami wasn't able to reschedule that meeting about her future plans she's having today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, but where's Saki?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She forgot to do her homework, so she's being forced to do extra worksheets.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honestly...
That's why you shouldn't get a big head.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She was over the moon about winning that practice match. She even sent us that update as soon as it was over.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, it'll just be us for lunch today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I couldn't get all four of us to gather for lunch, but it's been so long since I last got to eat with Shiho.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I know. The school store is supposed to be selling some peculiar yakisoba buns today, so I'll buy some for Saki and Honam—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, it's from the record company...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hello, this is Hinomori...
What? Yes, I'm having lunch right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki and Honami won't be joining us, so we can try doing this again another time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The others are always so busy.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm probably the only one having a lazy lunch like this.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, it's from Shiho...
What did she say?

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Message
rows.Line:
<Sorry about earlier.
It was an important matter, so I'm glad I was able to deal with it immediately.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Message
rows.Line: <Also, can you tell me more about those peculiar yakisoba buns?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll reply... “They're topped with spicy fish roe and mustard mayo.”
After school

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew... I've finished making my cutouts.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We also just finished making ours!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Which means...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The cutouts are all done.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Next, we need to put these all together and see if it forms a planetarium, don't we?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah!
But we probably don't have enough time to finish, so we might want to call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Thank you all for working so hard again today. Anyone who's free tomorrow, I hope to see you then!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow.
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(All the cutouts were so big.
Each one took a really long time to make, so I'm glad we were able to finish...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Still, if making paper cutouts was this hard, then using them to make cardboard cutouts is going to be difficult too.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We still have plenty of time until the school festival, but I should try to help out whenever I can.)
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_005

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Was that a band playing just now...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Are they going to perform during the school festival?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A band... That reminds me of...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: We should play a Miku song together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We couldn't get in sync at all, and kept making so many mistakes...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I was so happy about how we actually got to try playing a Miku song together.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was really fun...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I keep hoping that we'll get our band back together someday...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm probably the only one of us with that much free time on her hands.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't ask the others to drop everything for me the way I did back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, they're all trying so hard at what they're doing right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I should keep helping my class and do my best to finish writing my Miku song.
